models.description: First step for lookups, triage and small grounded questions. Escalate to openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:medium when needed.
Routine reading, summaries and bounded checks. Next main step is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-terra:low; V5 favors moving to Terra before increasing Luna effort.

First Terra step after Luna medium. Replaces Luna high, xhigh and max on the V5 task-cost frontier. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-terra:medium. AA-only deployment hypothesis; confirm with accepted Pi outcomes.
Broader investigation and scoped changes after Terra low. Sol low is also on the V5 frontier, but Terra medium offers a higher score for a small premium. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-terra:high.
Last Terra step in this menu. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:medium; it dominates Terra xhigh on V5 score and task cost.
First Sol step for substantial changes and hard debugging after Terra high. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:high. Task guidance remains provisional until tested in Pi.
More thinking for work Sol medium did not finish. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:xhigh.
Harder code and judgment after Sol high. Dominates Terra max on V5 score and task cost. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:max.
Last Sol step. If still blocked, return evidence to the parent or explicitly choose claude-subscription/claude-opus-5-5:xhigh for a costly cross-family escalation.

Optional final step beyond Sol max, and p3stack judgment/prose roles. Higher V5 score at a substantial task-cost premium. Stop at xhigh in this menu. AA Default Fallback; subscription equivalence remains unverified.
First Grok backup when conserving or lacking ChatGPT and Claude capacity. Older Grok 4.6 efforts have no complete V5 measurement. Next backup step is xai/grok-4.7:high.
Next Grok backup step and p3stack code roles. Return to the primary pool when available; V5 does not support escalating to Grok xhigh for general value.
Retained for p3stack code roles at the large budget. V5 high dominates this effort; keep only for workflow compatibility or task-specific evidence, not as the default backup escalation.
Cheapest Claude-pool option for bounded reading and triage while conserving ChatGPT capacity. Next compact Claude step is claude-subscription/claude-haiku-5-5:high.
Next compact Claude step after Haiku low. On the global V5 frontier. Next Claude step is claude-subscription/claude-haiku-5-5:xhigh.
More thorough bounded checks and light review within the Claude pool. Retained as a pool alternative despite global dominance. Next Claude step is claude-subscription/claude-sonnet-5-5:high.

Claude reviewer after Haiku xhigh, especially while conserving ChatGPT capacity. Next Claude step is claude-subscription/claude-opus-5-5:medium. Globally dominated on V5; retained for pool and review diversity.
First Opus step within the Claude pool after Sonnet high. Next is claude-subscription/claude-opus-5-5:high. AA Default Fallback; confirm with Pi outcomes.

Next Claude-pool step after Opus medium. A cheaper Opus review option than xhigh, but no longer an upgrade beyond Sol max on V5. Next Claude step is claude-subscription/claude-opus-5-5:xhigh. AA Default Fallback; confirm with Pi outcomes.
